anomalies.observed: Screw terminal J2 pin 2 is on NET0016, the same net as the ESP32 GPIO1 drive output (U11.13), the TPS1H200 IN and DIAG_EN pins (U2.1, U2.2) and the anode of the heater indicator D7. J2 is a bare, unprotected 3.3 V logic net exposed on a field-wiring terminal. The switched heater output is OUT on J13.2 (Net-(J13-Pin_2)).
anomalies.expected: Any field-wired heater or power output should be driven from the high-side switch OUT net, not from the MCU GPIO drive net. Connecting a terminal directly to the logic drive node would bypass the over-current-limited switch and could put the GPIO pin in contact with external wiring.
anomalies.impact: If J2 is a heater or load connection, the load is driven directly from the ESP32 GPIO1 with no current limit or fault protection, which could damage the MCU. If J2 is an unrelated signal terminal, its role is undocumented and it is a logic node exposed on a field connector.
